channel.title: HackerOne — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by HackerOne (hackerone).

item.title: CVE-2026-56848 · 7.5 HIGH
item.description: A flaw in Node.js HTTP/2 handling allows `nghttp2_session_mem_send()` to be called re-entrantly while `nghttp2_session_mem_recv()` is executing, resulting in a heap-use-after-free. This vulnerability affects Node.js **26.x**, **24.x**, and **22.x**.
